upstream.description: An 8-stage, hands-on curriculum from your first LLM API call to a hardened, hybrid cloud/local multi-agent system — built live, with every real bug found along the way documented, not hidden.

classification.analysis: zero-to-hardened-agents is an 8-stage, hands-on Python curriculum taking a learner from a raw LLM API call to a hardened, hybrid cloud/local multi-agent system, with each stage runnable and verifiable on its own: basic API calls, a first RAG app that refuses to hallucinate outside its sources, manual tool-calling, real vector search with ChromaDB, a multi-tab Gradio agentic app, a multi-agent DAG with a runaway-loop governor, a cloud/local hybrid router with failover, and an automated adversarial test suite (prompt injection, RAG poisoning, PII containment) mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Notably built as a real two-agent collaboration (Gemini/Antigravity for architecture planning, Claude Code as the sole code-writer) with a full logged handoff history, and every real bug hit along the way documented rather than hidden.

use_cases.title: Learn to build a multi-agent system step by step from a raw LLM call to a hardened deployment
Reference a runaway-loop governor pattern for multi-agent DAG orchestration
Build an adversarial test suite against prompt injection and RAG poisoning for your own agent
Route queries between a cloud LLM and a local Ollama model based on sensitivity and complexity
